name: Bulk RNA-seq from FASTQ
summary: FASTQ to differential expression: fastp, salmon, PyDESeq2, GSEA, HTML report.
description: Quantifies bulk RNA-seq libraries and tests for differential expression. Trims and checks reads with fastp and quantifies them with salmon against a salmon index, summarized to length-scaled gene counts as tximport does (rnaseq-quant), fits DESeq2 models with PyDESeq2 and runs preranked GSEA on Hallmark and GO:BP sets (bulk-de), and writes an HTML report with sample QC, PCA, volcano and MA plots and citations (bulk-report). The index comes from Pennsieve's reference data (human GENCODE 50 by default, or mouse GENCODE M39); for another organism or annotation, build one with the Build a salmon index workflow and link it to the Genome input. Sample metadata comes from a samples.csv or the dataset's SPARC subjects/samples sheets; set bulk-de's DESIGN (e.g. ~ sex + condition) and CONTRASTS for your study. If you used Pennsieve to store, analyse, share or publish data reported in a publication, please cite Goldblum Z, et al. Scientific Data 2025;12:1834 (doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06075-5), the datasets you used and the methods listed in the report.

inputs.name: FASTQ reads
inputs.description: A folder of .fastq.gz files (single- or paired-end; Illumina names or a samples.csv), with optional SPARC samples.xlsx / subjects.xlsx.

inputs.name: Genome
inputs.description: The salmon index: Pennsieve's reference data (human by default, or mouse), or an index in a dataset (Build a salmon index).
